summary: Container Security
description: Implement container image security controls including vulnerability scanning, CIS benchmark hardening, and image signing to ensure all container artifacts meet organizational security standards.

summary: Integrate Trivy scanning into container build pipeline
description: Add a Trivy scan step to the GitLab CI pipeline that evaluates newly built container images and fails the pipeline on high‑severity vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a newly built container image, when the pipeline runs the Trivy scan, then any HIGH or CRITICAL severity vulnerabilities cause the pipeline to fail.
Given a successful scan, then a detailed scan report is attached as a pipeline artifact.
parent: Container Security

summary: Configure Trivy in CI environment
description: Install Trivy in the CI runner, add configuration files, and verify it can run locally.
parent: Integrate Trivy scanning into container build pipeline

summary: Add Trivy scan job to .gitlab-ci.yml
description: Create a new job that runs after the image build step, executes Trivy against the built image, and captures the exit code.
parent: Integrate Trivy scanning into container build pipeline

summary: Implement failure rule and report publishing
description: Set the job to fail on HIGH/CRITICAL findings and publish the scan report as an artifact.
parent: Integrate Trivy scanning into container build pipeline

summary: Apply CIS Docker Benchmark hardening to base images
description: Automate CIS Docker Benchmark checks on base images and enforce compliance before images are promoted.
dependencies: Integrate Trivy scanning into container build pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Given a base image, when the CIS benchmark job runs, then any non‑compliant configuration is reported in the job output.
Given a compliant image, then the job passes and a compliance badge is generated for the pipeline.
parent: Container Security

summary: Select and install CIS benchmark tool
description: Choose a tool such as Docker Bench for Security, add it to the CI runner, and verify execution.
parent: Apply CIS Docker Benchmark hardening to base images

summary: Create compliance job in .gitlab-ci.yml
description: Add a job that runs the benchmark against the built image and captures results.
parent: Apply CIS Docker Benchmark hardening to base images

summary: Generate compliance report and badge
description: Parse the benchmark output, fail the job on violations, and produce a badge artifact for visibility.
parent: Apply CIS Docker Benchmark hardening to base images

summary: Implement container image signing and verification
description: Sign container images after they pass scanning and hardening, and verify signatures during deployment to prevent tampering.
dependencies: Apply CIS Docker Benchmark hardening to base images
acceptance_criteria: Given a successfully built and scanned image, when the signing job runs, then the image is signed and the signature is stored as an artifact.
Given a signed image, when the deployment stage pulls the image, then a verification step ensures the signature is valid and fails the pipeline if verification fails.
parent: Container Security

summary: Set up Cosign (or Notary) signing tool
description: Install the signing tool in the CI environment and configure keys for signing.
parent: Implement container image signing and verification

summary: Add signing job after successful scans
description: Create a CI job that signs the image, uploads the signature, and records the signed image tag.
parent: Implement container image signing and verification

summary: Add verification step in deployment stage
description: Implement a job that verifies the image signature before deployment and aborts on failure.
parent: Implement container image signing and verification

summary: CI/CD Pipeline Security
description: Strengthen the GitLab CI/CD pipeline by integrating static code analysis, enforcing OWASP guidelines, and detecting hard‑coded secrets.

summary: Integrate Snyk static code analysis into GitLab CI
description: Run Snyk SAST on each code commit and fail the pipeline on critical vulnerabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code commit, when the Snyk job runs, then any CRITICAL vulnerability causes the pipeline to fail.
Given no critical issues, then the pipeline proceeds and a Snyk report is attached as an artifact.
parent: CI/CD Pipeline Security

summary: Configure Snyk CLI in CI environment
description: Install the Snyk CLI on the runner and add authentication tokens.
parent: Integrate Snyk static code analysis into GitLab CI

summary: Add Snyk scan job to .gitlab-ci.yml
description: Create a job that runs `snyk test` on the codebase and captures the exit status.
parent: Integrate Snyk static code analysis into GitLab CI

summary: Set failure thresholds and publish report
description: Configure the job to fail on CRITICAL findings and store the Snyk HTML/JSON report as an artifact.
parent: Integrate Snyk static code analysis into GitLab CI

summary: Enforce OWASP CI/CD guidelines in pipeline configuration
description: Validate pipeline definitions against OWASP CI/CD best‑practice checklist and block non‑compliant merges.
dependencies: Integrate Snyk static code analysis into GitLab CI
acceptance_criteria: Given a merge request, when the OWASP validation job runs, then any guideline violation (e.g., insecure secret handling) blocks the merge.
Given a compliant pipeline, then a compliance badge is added to the merge request.
parent: CI/CD Pipeline Security

summary: Define OWASP CI/CD checklist
description: Document required checks such as secret handling, image provenance, and least‑privilege runner settings.
parent: Enforce OWASP CI/CD guidelines in pipeline configuration

summary: Implement validation job in .gitlab-ci.yml
description: Add a job that lints the pipeline YAML against the checklist and returns a pass/fail status.
parent: Enforce OWASP CI/CD guidelines in pipeline configuration

summary: Publish compliance report and enforce MR rule
description: Generate a report artifact, add a badge, and configure GitLab to prevent merging when the job fails.
parent: Enforce OWASP CI/CD guidelines in pipeline configuration
